d: Who We Are: At Huda Beauty, our Vision is to lead in creating a democratized beauty industry where power is given back to people to define, create, and enjoy beauty for themselves! Launched by award-winning beauty powerhouse Huda Kattan in 2013, Huda Beauty is one of the world’s fastest growing beauty brands. As a company, we are fueled by purpose and not profit, this allows us to approach things differently so that we can create products, content, and a community like no other. A lot has changed since our launch in 2013, but something that will forever remain at the core of Huda Beauty is our focus on business excellence and our unwavering passion for kindness!

Summary: We are looking for a highly motivated and detail-oriented Influencer Marketing Intern to join our dynamic Global Influencer team here at Huda Beauty. This role offers hands-on experience supporting global influencer campaigns, with a focus on global Influencer kit ideation, trend research, and operational logistics.
Please not that this internship is 6-month fixed-term contract role.
q: Demonstrates an understanding of social media campaigns across various platforms.
Strong knowledge of social media platforms, best practices, and trends.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Flexibility to work outside of standard hours to ensure specific pieces of content are being engaged with.
Ability to multitask and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Demonstrated attention to detail and accuracy in fast-paced, deadline-driven environments.
Track record of delivering results both independently and as part of a cross-functional team.
Fluent on IG & all social media platforms including Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, & Snapchat
Experience in Beauty & Cosmetics is preferred
Track record of generating original, out-of-the-box ideas for campaigns and content
Proficient writer with the ability to adapt language and messaging depending on platform and audience
Demonstrated problem-solving and analytical skills applied to campaign or logistics challenges
Experience building relationships and communicating with a consumer-focused approach
Current student or recent graduate with Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, or related field.
r: Assist in brainstorming and developing creative PR kit concepts tailored to campaign themes and trends.
Research and present relevant influencer and social media, cultural trends to help guide ideation.
Conduct competitor analysis to track and report on PR kit trends across the beauty and lifestyle space
Coordinate sample requests with internal teams and vendors, particularly managing product logistics with suppliers
Ensure timely dispatch of samples for PR kits for approval
Liaise with logistics providers (e.g., DHL) to arrange international shipments
Prepare shipping documents and track deliveries to ensure successful and timely arrivals.
Organize influencer product databases, addresses, and kit distribution lists
Help manage campaign timelines and support with post-campaign reporting as needed
x: Monthly "Self Love Days" – at company discretion
Employee discounts on all Huda Beauty products

d: Calo is an app providing personalized meal plans for busy people through nutritional algorithms, built with love by chefs, nutritionists, and software engineers.

Launched in Bahrain in 2019, we have since expanded to 6 countries, delivered millions of meals to our customers, and are now expanding our mission of making healthy easy to retail and other verticals.
We're on a noble mission to make healthy easy. We think this is one of the most important problems to tackle in our world today. We have global ambitions - no small thinking here.

We are looking for a driven and relationship oriented Senior Business Development Specialist to grow Calo’s corporate and business partnerships. This role focuses on acquiring, managing, and expanding B2B accounts by offering Calo’s meal plans and wellness solutions to companies, organizations, and institutions.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field (preferred)
Minimum 3-4 years of experience in B2B sales
Arabic speaker with strong verbal and written communication skills
Must have a valid driver’s license
The ideal candidate is comfortable with consultative selling, understands corporate client needs, and is motivated by building long-term partnerships that deliver value to both Calo and its clients.
r: Identify and prospect new B2B clients
Present Calo’s products and solutions to decision-makers
Develop tailored proposals and close deals
Coordinate with internal teams for smooth onboarding

d: Lead FLS operational compliance and performance monitoring across City Operations, including governance and oversight of the Fire and Rescue Service and FLS compliance within Facilities Management. Ensure operational assets, service providers and response arrangements remain compliant, ready and effective through risk-based inspections, audits, performance monitoring and corrective-action management.
Lead the City Operations FLS operational compliance and monitoring function.
Establish an operational FLS compliance framework covering occupied assets, public spaces, Facilities Management and the Fire and Rescue Service.

Provide governance and performance oversight of the Fire and Rescue Service, including contractual requirements, readiness, response capability, staffing, training, equipment and performance reporting.
Monitor Facilities Management delivery of preventive maintenance, inspection, testing, impairment control and defect rectification for FLS systems.
Develop risk-based inspection and audit programs to verify continued compliance across operational assets and service-provider activities.
Define FLS operational KPIs and leading indicators, analyze trends and report material gaps and emerging risks to leadership.
Oversee non-compliance, impairment, deficiency and corrective-action processes, ensuring timely escalation and verified closure.
Coordinate FLS interfaces between FM, Asset Management, CCU, SSOC, Operational Resilience, security and the Fire and Rescue Service.
Support emergency preparedness, exercises, incident review and continual improvement of operational response arrangements.
Develop and maintain operational FLS compliance procedures, inspection schedules, dashboards and action registers.
Review FM and FRS service-provider plans, reports, records and performance against contractual and operational requirements.
Monitor critical fire-system impairments and ensure compensatory measures, escalation and restoration are effectively managed.
Conduct or coordinate operational inspections, audits, readiness checks and targeted assurance reviews.
Review incidents, unwanted alarms, system failures, response performance and recurring deficiencies to identify systemic improvement actions.
Provide FLS compliance input to asset changes, events, operational changes and occupancy decisions.
Maintain regulator and Civil Defense interfaces relating to operational FLS compliance and readiness.
Contribute to annual business planning, workforce planning and budget management for the function.
Lead, coach and develop assigned teams and specialist service providers.
Promote a culture of accountability, prevention, continual improvement and evidence-based decision-making.
Maintain accurate records and provide timely reports, presentations and recommendations to City Operations leadership.
Perform other related duties consistent with the role and business requirements.
City Operations leadership and FLS & HSWW teams
Civil Defence and other relevant authorities
Fire-system maintenance contractors and specialist vendors
Independent auditors, testing bodies and technical advisors
Developers and delivery partners during operational transition
q: Bachelor’s degree in Fire Engineering, Fire Protection Engineering, Emergency Management, Engineering, Facilities Management or a closely related discipline.
Master’s degree in a relevant field is desirable.
Relevant professional qualification in fire safety, fire engineering, emergency management, auditing or facilities management is desirable.
Professional registration or membership with a recognized FLS or engineering body is desirable
Expert knowledge of operational fire safety compliance, fire-protection system maintenance, emergency-response readiness and assurance.
Strong knowledge of Fire and Rescue Service governance and Facilities Management interfaces.
Strong inspection, audit, contract-performance monitoring, data analysis and corrective-action skills.
Ability to interpret operational risks and provide practical, risk-based recommendations to senior leadership.
Strong leadership, stakeholder management, reporting and service-provider management capability.
